svg.title: The Communication Tool Avalanche across biological evolution, pre-registered ratchet models, and neural interface gating
svg.desc: Three-band synthesis diagram on a dark canvas. Band A shows the conserved Externalize, Threshold-and-Verify, and Transform-and-Lock operator alongside six escalation epochs from 3.8 billion years ago to attested orchestration graphs and predicted agency-preserving brain-computer interfaces. Band B plots exact outputs from executed models CA-M1 through CA-M5 (seed 20261123): cooperative Hill quorum ATP savings (95.5% for n=2, 99.2% for n=4) and SepJ nanopore survival (95.0% vs 0.0% ungated); topological k=7 flock cohesion (100.0% vs 0.7%-4.3% metric) and Physarum shortest-path selection (100.0% flux for mu > 1); and 20-generation cultural ratchet retention after demonstrator removal at generation 5 (100.0% attested library vs 76.3% prestige imitation, 29.3% unverified imitation, and 0.0% baseline). Band C maps the transition from read-only sensing to closed-loop modulation, preclinical extracellular vesicles, and opt-in N-mind bridging proved in Lean 4 theorems T29 to T31.
